Class JSeshBundledAction

java.lang.Object
  javax.swing.AbstractAction

All Implemented Interfaces:
javax.swing.Action, java.awt.event.ActionListener, java.lang.Cloneable, java.util.EventListener, java.io.Serializable
public class JSeshBundledAction
extends BundledAction

Variant of Bundled Action for JSesh.

Introduces Icons with manuel de codage description.

It would make it possible to Localize our system for ancient Thebes.
